title: provider file
description: One inference provider under the home's providers directory: an endpoint, the models it serves and an optional secret reference.
$comment: A literal secret is never valid anywhere. The secret field accepts only a secret:// reference. The token-shaped check on every other string is applied by stratarc.providers.validate, which a schema cannot express.

endpoint.description: An http or https URL without credentials or a query string.

secret.description: A secret:// reference that a configured provider resolves at run time.
